data.one_liner: A dotted 3D globe widget with lat/lng markers and great-circle arcs.
data.what_it_does: Renders a rotatable 3D globe composed of halftone land dots. Allows placing custom Flutter widgets at specific latitude and longitude coordinates, drawing great-circle arcs between points, and controlling the view programmatically or via gestures.
use_when: You want to display global data, statistics, or connections on a stylish 3D globe.
You need custom interactive widgets pinned to geographic coordinates.
You require a zero-dependency pure Dart globe solution.
avoid_when: You need a fully detailed interactive street map or tile-based navigation engine.
You need offline geocoding, routing, or extensive map GIS data processing.
strengths: Pure Dart with zero external dependencies.
High performance with transform-only marker repositioning.
Includes multiple visual color presets and great-circle arc rendering.
weaknesses: Limited to stylized halftone dots rather than high-resolution satellite imagery or vector tiles.
Not suited for standard geographical mapping or routing use cases.
